sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Irresistible is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "I got word from my buddy that there's a special merchandise in town. You like movies? Then you'll certainly recognize this gun! There's only one little issue. The cargo went missing near the Ultra mall, I think somebody snatched it up. But man do I need these shotguns. It's a damn exclusive, you know what I'm saying? Anyway, why don't you take a little trip to Ultra and find this weapon crate there? If you get it, I'll pay you real good."

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Locate and obtain the lost weapon crate on Interchange
- Hand over the retrieved cargo

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- 1,650 Euros
  - 1,732 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,897 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1x MPS Auto Assault-12 Gen 1 12ga automatic shotgun
- 2x 12/70 flechette ammo pack (25 pcs)
- Unlocks purchase of MPS Auto Assault-12 Gen 1 12ga automatic shotgun at Skier LL3
"Atta boy! It'll sell real good real quick, I'm telling you! Not many guns can boast such a flashy advertisement..."

| Stolen weapon case | Stolen weapon case | 1 | Handover item | Yes | This quest item can only be found if the quest is active.; When picked up, this item is transferred to the player's quest item inventory.; If the player fails to extract with this item, they will lose it. |
The lost weapon crate can be found inside a red container at the container lot in the southwest of the mall on Interchange. Activated power station power and Object #21WS keycard required.
